project.name: Cubeage Solar2D Singular Plugin
project.summary: Self-hosted Solar2D native plugin for the Singular attribution SDK, owning Android plugin source, Solar2D metadata, and GitHub Release package artifacts consumed by games.
goals: Maintain the Solar2D plugin.singular integration for Singular attribution and event reporting.
Package Android release artifacts that Solar2D apps can consume from GitHub Releases.
Keep Singular SDK versioning, Solar2D metadata, and platform support limits explicit.
nonGoals: Do not own game-specific attribution policy, marketing analytics decisions, or app runtime behavior.
Do not own the upstream Singular SDK or Solar2D runtime.
Do not own central CI runner, enterprise release bot, or platform preview behavior.

owns.name: solar2d-singular-lua-api
owns.description: The plugin.singular Lua-facing API and event contract documented for Solar2D apps.

owns.name: solar2d-singular-android-code
owns.description: Android native plugin source that bridges Solar2D to Singular SDK behavior.

owns.name: solar2d-singular-release-artifact
owns.description: GitHub Release package artifact android.tgz consumed by Solar2D build settings.

doesNotOwn: Game-specific attribution policy, marketing analytics decisions, monetization behavior, or app runtime behavior.
Upstream Singular SDK releases, Solar2D runtime behavior, or app-store submission policy.
Central Sylphx preview platform, central CI runner capacity, branch protection policy, or enterprise release bot behavior.

allowedDependencies.surface: Solar2D SDK release assets and runtime headers

forbiddenCouplings: Do not add game-specific attribution policy, monetization behavior, or analytics decisions to the reusable plugin.
Do not consume private app internals from plugin code.
Do not treat source revert as sufficient recovery after release artifacts have been published.
Do not encode central release-bot, runner-capacity, secret-management, or branch-protection policy as plugin behavior.

delivery.deployPath: Release artifacts are built by .github/workflows/build-android.yml and published by .github/workflows/release.yml on v* tag pushes. No required PR status context is currently configured in branch protection.
delivery.productionProof: Release changes require Android build artifacts, package smoke evidence, GitHub Release asset readback, and consumer compatibility notes for affected apps. Manifest-only changes are proven by the doctrine project-control audit.

packageRelease.releaseIntent: Current state is a v* tag-triggered release workflow; dedicated release-intent PR is not yet adopted.
packageRelease.versionPr: Not currently implemented; future path should use a bot-owned version or release PR before tag publication.
packageRelease.publisher: .github/workflows/release.yml currently publishes with repository workflow permissions; future path should use a dedicated least-privilege release GitHub App or bot.
packageRelease.publishProof: GitHub Release readback for android.tgz plus package smoke evidence.

gaps.description: Branch protection has no required PR status contexts for plugin or package changes.
Package release is tag-triggered and currently lacks a dedicated release GitHub App or bot-owned version PR.
Repository has not adopted central ADR-29 stable admission fan-in contexts.
gaps.target: Central CI runner and admission control plane
